Phosphor Icons (ImageVector subset)
===================================

Vendored asset: the path data in `../src/main/kotlin/com/taffygo/browser/ui/core/ui/TaffyIconPaths.kt`
                and `../src/main/kotlin/com/taffygo/browser/ui/core/ui/TaffyIconCanvasPaths.kt`
                and the ImageVector vals in `../src/main/kotlin/com/taffygo/browser/ui/core/ui/TaffyIcon.kt`
                (a subset of 80 glyphs, Phosphor Icons, MIT)
Licence:        MIT (vendor/phosphor.MIT.txt, next to this file)
Source:         https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/phosphor-icons/core@main/assets/<weight>/<name>.svg
                for the regular weight, and .../assets/<weight>/<name>-<weight>.svg
                for every other one (the jsDelivr mirror of phosphor-icons/core@main;
                raw.githubusercontent.com was rate-limited)
Licence source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/phosphor-icons/core@main/LICENSE
Downloaded:     2026-08-17, the first-run glyphs on 2026-08-18,
                magnifying-glass and dots-three-vertical on 2026-08-19, and
                speaker-high and speaker-slash on 2026-08-21, sun, moon-stars,
                gear, trash, table, arrow-up-right and image on 2026-08-22, and
                the fill weights of sun and moon-stars on 2026-08-23, and
                books, download-simple and squares-four on 2026-08-25, and
                user-circle, clock, identification-card, newspaper, monitor,
                star and sliders-horizontal on 2026-08-28, and caret-left,
                copy-simple, translate, funnel, chart-bar, question, text-aa
                and flag on 2026-08-29, and minus on 2026-09-01, and
                arrow-up on 2026-09-02, and play on 2026-09-10

glyphs=80

The 79 glyphs, each a single filled path on the source's 256 viewport,
transcribed into `ImageVector.Builder` calls with no hand-editing:

  regular: lock-simple, shield-check, arrow-clockwise, waveform, sparkle,
           prohibit, browsers, share-network, arrow-left, arrow-right, arrow-up, plus,
           minus,
           x, pencil-simple, clock-counter-clockwise, bookmark-simple,
           article, chat-circle, password, globe-simple, info, key, tag,
           envelope-simple, cloud, arrows-clockwise, cloud-arrow-up,
           puzzle-piece, bell-ringing, magnifying-glass, dots-three-vertical,
           speaker-high, speaker-slash, sun, moon-stars, gear, trash, table,
           arrow-up-right, image, books, download-simple, squares-four,
           user-circle, clock, identification-card, newspaper, monitor, star,
           sliders-horizontal, copy-simple, translate, funnel, chart-bar,
           question, text-aa, flag
  fill:    pause, play, hand, check-circle, circle-half, stop-circle, warning,
           eye-slash, hand-pointing, users-three, house, crown-simple,
           detective, film-strip, export, gift, sun, moon-stars
  bold:    check, caret-down, caret-right, caret-left (bold because none has
           a fill weight — DESIGN.md §4)

Weights follow `handoff/DESIGN.md` section 4: regular for controls, fill for
status glyphs, bold only where fill does not exist.

sun and moon-stars are vendored twice, in both weights, and both are used. The
regular pair is the Appearance control on screen SCR-001, which is a control.
The fill pair is the body of the theme transition, which is not: nothing taps
it, and it draws about five times larger than the biggest icon size section 4
lists, where regular strokes thin to hairlines.
